scope: A supplemental source-level spelling/identity-boundary check after the earlier Q04K attribution and name-variant reviews. It does not repeat or replace those records; it documents one additional biographical witness. It does not adjudicate the historical identity of Qurtubi's quoted authority, authenticate Hilal's statement, establish a route, draft a database translation, clear any hold, or publish.

source_anchors.locator: Surah 108:1, interpretation list, item 13; KSU electronic page label 602, line 48
source_anchors.finding: The commentary names Hilal ibn Yasaf as the speaker for this view; that clause itself gives no transmission chain.

source_anchors.work: Al-Mizzi, Tahdhib al-Kamal fi Asma al-Rijal
source_anchors.exact_name_form: هلال بن يساف ، ويقال : ابن إساف
source_anchors.finding: The biographical entry records 'Ibn Isaf' as an alternate name form under the entry headed Hilal ibn Yasaf.

source_anchors.locator: vol. 11, printed p. 76, biographical entry no. 144, note (3)
source_anchors.exact_name_form: هلال بن يساف ويقال ابن أساف الأشجعي
source_anchors.finding: A second biographical work also records Ibn Asaf as an alternate form and identifies the name entry. Its note refers to Tahdhib al-Kamal; treat it as corroborating lexicographical/biographical recording, not an independent historical attestation of Qurtubi's quoted statement.

bounded_finding.claim: Qurtubi's named form Hilal ibn Yasaf is compatible with a biographical variant recorded as Ibn Isaf/Ibn Asaf in later rijal references.
bounded_finding.scope_limit: Name-form correspondence alone does not prove the historical identity of the person intended in this specific Qurtubi report, the accuracy/authenticity of the attributed view, or any route of transmission to Qurtubi.
bounded_finding.qurtubi_voice: Qurtubi reports the named interpretation; the wording does not make the statement Qurtubi's own preferred view.
bounded_finding.transmission_route: none stated in the Q04K clause; none added

translation.research_gloss: Hilal ibn Yasaf identifies al-Kawthar with the testimony that there is no deity but God and Muhammad is God's messenger.
